visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Gallery shows one picture per row
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This gallery should show two squares per row, but every square is on its own row. The grid has no columns defined.

solution.explanation: Without grid-template-columns a grid has a single column, so the items stack. Define the columns, for example 1fr 1fr, and the items fill each row from left to right.

checks.label: The first two squares share a row
The third square starts a new row
